module worker@1 [
  def on_submit [
    swap unpair
    [
      drop 1 + swap
      dup unpair drop inr
      swap [ pair WorkerData@1.State.new ] dip
      WorkerData@1.Action.Send nil cons
    ]
    [
      inr pair WorkerData@1.State.new
      swap drop nil
    ] case
  ]
  def on_cancel [
    swap unpair
    [
      inl pair WorkerData@1.State.new
      swap drop nil
    ]
    [
      [ swap ] dip
      dup WorkerData@1.AttemptId.into
      [ swap ] dip
      [ WorkerData@1.AttemptId.into ] dip
      =
      [ drop unit inl pair WorkerData@1.State.new nil ]
      [ inr pair WorkerData@1.State.new nil ] if
    ] case
  ]
  export transition
  def transition [
    swap WorkerData@1.State.into swap
    [ on_submit ] [ on_cancel ] WorkerData@1.Event.match
  ]
]
